recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical collage featuring a man in a dual-environment scene, bisected by a diagonal torn-paper edge. The top-left shows a snowy forest with the man in formal attire; the bottom-right shows a grassy field with the man in casual wear. The entire collage is mounted on a textured white card with handwritten text at the bottom, all set against a vibrant, grainy orange background.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal torn-paper edge separating two distinct seasonal environments
Central vertical white rectangle acting as a frame within a frame
High-contrast relationship between the saturated orange border and the desaturated photographic elements
coreInvariants: Grainy, tactile paper texture across all surfaces
Rough, fibrous white edge on the diagonal tear
Centered vertical alignment of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is centered vertically and horizontally within the white inner frame, occupying approximately 60% of its height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the sharp diagonal tear line serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the diagonal tear downward to the handwritten text, and then expands to the orange border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the wide orange border and the white margins of the inner card.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neutral white (inner card and torn paper edge)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blacks and blues (subject's clothing and forest shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the periphery (orange) contrasting with low-to-medium saturation in the central photographic collage.

letterConstructionRules: Varying heights with elongated vertical stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'o' and 'f' rendered with minimal loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single handwritten style to maintain a personal, 'scrapbook' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, thin, and slightly irregular verticality of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical collage of a man. The top-left half is a snowy winter forest with the man in a black blazer. The bottom-right half is a grassy field with the man in a plaid shirt and jeans. Separate the two halves with a diagonal, rough, white torn-paper edge. Place this collage on a textured white rectangular card, then place that card on a large, grainy, vibrant orange background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, black, handwritten-style text centered in the white space below the collage. The text should look like it was written with a fine-liner pen.

verificationChecks: Is the orange background heavily textured/grainy?
Does the diagonal tear have a visible white fibrous edge?
Is the text thin and clearly handwritten rather than a standard font?
Are the two scenes (snowy vs. grassy) distinctly separated?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the torn paper diagonal
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white card has a subtle drop shadow or edge definition against the orange.
Verify the grain is consistent across the entire image.
Check that the subject's position aligns across the tear line.
Confirm the handwriting is legible but informal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vertical collage + diagonal torn-paper split + textured white frame + vibrant grainy border + handwritten footer.
